name: Echo Grotto
mechanic: emit sonar pings to briefly paint a pitch-black cave in sound while lurking beasts home in on your echoes
theme: a blind bat feeling its way through five lightless caverns toward daylight
tagline: You were born blind. Sound is your sight.
controls: arrows / WASD or hold to glide, tap or space to ping

name: Muster!
mechanic: herd a flock by pressure - sheep flee the dog, so you push from behind and bark to scatter them, scare wolves or enrage the ram
theme: a sheepdog working five sunlit fields against the clock
tagline: The flock has opinions. You have a whistle.
controls: mouse / touch or WASD / arrows to run, space or B to bark

name: Perihelion Post
mechanic: drag to launch a mail pod along a live-predicted trajectory, planetary gravity slingshots the flight and scarce thruster burns correct course into the delivery ring
theme: a solo courier drone running eight alien star systems on gravity alone
tagline: Aim once. Let the planets do the rest.
controls: mouse / touch drag to aim & launch, WASD / arrows or hold to thrust, space recalls the pod

name: Orbit Post
mechanic: drag-release slingshot throws of a mail pod bent by planetary gravity into a drop ring, with a live trajectory forecast and orbiting moon hazards
theme: an interplanetary courier service running five delivery runs between planets and moons
tagline: Gravity does the flying. You just let go at the right moment.
controls: mouse / touch drag or arrows + space

name: Night Junction
mechanic: flip track levers in real time to steer colour-coded steam trains into their matching stations, juggling occupied platforms and rear-end collisions
theme: a lone signalman running a storm-lit mountain junction box with three lanterns and an unfinished east line
tagline: Every lever is a promise. Keep it.
controls: mouse / touch tap levers or keys 1-3, P pause, R restart, M sound

name: Shadow Stage
mechanic: drag translucent shadow puppets across a lantern-lit screen and resize them by pushing them toward the flame, assembling each fable's silhouette against a live likeness meter before the audience's patience runs out
theme: a travelling shadow-puppet theatre performing seven paper fables behind one guttering oil lamp
tagline: Closer to the flame, bolder the shadow.
controls: mouse / touch drag shadows & gold resize knob, scroll or -/+ to resize, arrows nudge, Tab cycles, Enter presents, R restarts, M sound

name: Static Watch
mechanic: sweep an analogue dial to hunt drifting radio carriers by a falling beat-tone whistle and magic-eye glow, then hold the needle inside the lock window to log each voice
theme: the night wireless watch aboard a 1962 North Sea trawler, pulling ghost voices out of storm static
tagline: Somewhere in the static, someone is calling.
controls: mouse / touch drag or click the dial, arrows sweep, up/down fine trim, M mute, P pause, R restart

name: Chartwright
mechanic: glimpse a fog-bound island for a few seconds, then redraw its coastline freehand from memory - your ink is scored by how much of the true landmass it captures
theme: a ship's cartographer in a fogbound archipelago, redrawing charts lost overboard before landfall
tagline: The chart went overboard. Redraw it before landfall.
controls: mouse / touch to draw, Z undo, C clear, Space commits

name: Live Wire
mechanic: hold and drag a live spark along glowing circuit traces, balancing on the copper through sweeping rotor arms, timed capacitor flares and patrolling solder bugs without drifting off the trace
theme: a spark of current restoring five failing boards of a darkened mainframe on three fuses
tagline: Steady hands carry the current.
controls: mouse / touch hold & drag, arrows or WASD nudge, P pause, M sound, R restart

name: Anvil Song
mechanic: strike the hammer when a sweeping mark crosses the glowing zone while bellows-feeding heat and rationing one shared coal bed, then quench each blade true
theme: a storm-lit mountain smithy forging five blades over a single dying coal bed
tagline: Iron remembers every blow.
controls: space / enter or tap to strike, hold B or the bellows button to reheat, P pause, M sound, R restart

name: Hot Metal
mechanic: type the word carried by each slug of loose type before it reaches the wet page; mistyped keys break your pay chain, red slugs run fast for double pay, gilded slugs lift a smudge when set
theme: a midnight hand-printing shop where the type case has spilled and the press never stops until the dawn bell
tagline: Catch the words before the ink sets.
controls: keyboard letters; on-screen keys on touch; backspace or escape drops a held slug; buttons pause, mute, restart

name: Bad Penny
mechanic: load equal numbers of suspect coins on a two-pan balance, read each tilt as evidence that one counterfeit runs heavy or light, and accuse it before your limited weighings are spent
theme: an assayer's chamber in the royal mint, testing suspect batches under the magistrate's three wax seals
tagline: Every batch hides one lying coin. The scales never lie.
controls: mouse / touch tap coins (left pan, right pan, back), or arrows + A/D/S to place, Enter weighs, E accuses then H/L swears heavy or light, C clear, M sound, R restart

name: Escapement
mechanic: drag spare gears onto brass pegs to mesh a weight-driven wheel into the clock's crown, each mesh reversing the turn while tooth sizes trade speed for reach, rusted dead gears blocking the road
theme: the night shift inside a stopped clocktower, rebuilding six stripped gear trains floor by floor before midnight
tagline: Every tooth must catch.
controls: mouse / touch tap-to-place or 1-3 pick up, arrows aim, enter drops / lifts, x unmeshes, R resets floor, M sound, P pause

name: Glass Plate
mechanic: pan and zoom a spirit camera across a haunted ballroom, framing flickering apparitions and timing the shutter for when each spirit burns brightest, spending twelve glass plates to fill a five-print album before dawn
theme: a midnight spirit-photography séance in a derelict manor house
tagline: Frame what flickers. Shoot while it burns.
controls: mouse / touch drag to pan, click / tap or Space shoots, scroll / pinch or + − zooms, R restarts, P pauses, M sound

name: Waggle Dance
mechanic: hold and steer a scout bee's waggle run on the vertical comb, encoding each flower patch's angle against the sun shaft and its distance as hold length while wind gusts shove you off-line, recruiting foragers that ferry nectar home to the comb
theme: a honeybee hive racing to seal six summer days of comb before winter settles over the meadow
tagline: Dance the map. The hive follows.
controls: hold space / touch-hold to waggle, arrows or drag to aim, release at the right ring, E eats honey, P pause, M sound, R restart

name: Bone Bed
mechanic: switch between a reckless pick that bites fast but cracks buried bone and a patient brush that frees it clean, spending scarce probe pings to ghost the skeleton through the rock
theme: a lone palaeontologist opening a sun-baked badlands quarry before the storm season
tagline: The rock kept it for sixty million years. Free it gently.
controls: mouse / touch hold to dig, keys or tap 1 / 2 / 3 for pick, brush, probe, P pause, M sound, R restart

name: Thin Ice
mechanic: skate tile-by-tile across a frozen pond where every crossing cracks the ice further, ferrying stranded skaters home in a rescue train whose growing weight breaks the ice faster
theme: a moonlit midwinter pond before dawn, skating out from a lamplit shore hut as cracks spread and holes slowly refreeze
tagline: The pond remembers every step.
controls: arrows / WASD to step, swipe or tap to skate, P pause, R restart, M sound

name: Midnight Broth
mechanic: drop the noodle basket into a live simmer ring, fill each ticket's topping slots while it cooks, then strain inside a shrinking green window before customer patience or the pot runs out
theme: a rain-slick midnight ramen yatai serving its last ten regulars before dawn
tagline: Ten hungry regulars. One pot of courage.
controls: mouse / touch taps or keys 1-5 toppings, space drops & strains, enter serves, P pause, M sound, R restart

name: Night Haul
mechanic: hold to sink a net to the right depth and release to snap it shut around drifting schools that bolt from the ropes, while eels hug the mud, moonfish rise late and one old carp haunts the deep
theme: a lantern-lit rowboat on a still mountain lake, filling the creel before the dawn bell rings you home
tagline: Sink it slow. Close it quick.
controls: drag to row or arrows, hold Net button / space / down to sink, release to close, P pause, M sound, R new night

name: Firebreak
mechanic: dig bare-soil firebreak lines and set risky backburns to starve a wind-driven wildfire before it reaches the cabins, while the wandering night wind and ember throws jump thin lines
theme: a drought-stressed homestead valley held through five night shifts of rising, shifting wind
tagline: You cannot put it out. Take its lunch.
controls: mouse / touch drag to cut & tap to burn, arrows + space cursor, Z / X tools, P pause, M sound, R restart

name: Foldsong
mechanic: fold a two-sided patterned sheet in half edge over edge, each crease flipping its layers plain-side-out, until the commissioned motif lies face-up - and the named motif hides just beneath - on the sealed packet
theme: a paper-folder's desk in a candlelit stationer's shop, working through six afternoon commissions
tagline: Every crease decides what shows.
controls: click / tap folded edges or arrow keys to fold, U undo, R restart order, P pause, M sound

name: Wick & Wing
mechanic: you never steer the moth - it always veers toward the nearest burning wick (and violet zappers burn brightest), so you snuff lanterns for free and relight them for scarce matches, chaining its flight through sleeping buds before dawn past brambles, crosswind gusts and a light-hunting bat
theme: a walled cottage garden across six nights of a fading moon, one matchbox between the moth and morning
tagline: You cannot fly. Choose what burns.
controls: mouse / touch tap lanterns or arrows + space, 1-9 direct, P pause, R restart, M sound

name: Going Once
mechanic: ration one purse across twelve lots under a falling hammer, outbidding three rivals whose visible quirks, ceilings and purses are the only appraisal you get
theme: a candlelit 1893 country auction house selling heirlooms of dubious provenance
tagline: Buy low before the hammer falls.
controls: mouse / touch buttons or space/B to bid, X to pass, P pause, R restart, M sound

name: Loop & Load
mechanic: program a looping command sequence that the depot bot repeats forever, threading it past shelves, oil slicks and patrol sweepers to grab each parcel, post it at the chute and roll onto the charge pad
theme: the last night shift of a parcel depot run by loop-fed courier robots
tagline: It only knows your loop. Make it a good one.
controls: mouse / touch tap commands and buttons, or keys F/L/R/W/G to program, Backspace erase, Enter or Space run/stop, R restart, P pause, M sound

name: Stitchwork
mechanic: fill each patch with the fabric it asks for to piece a quilt top, then sew every seam with its called-for thread colour before the oil lamp burns down - wrong thread snaps a needle
theme: a candlelit sewing room working five blocks of a winter commission
tagline: Every seam asks its own colour.
controls: mouse / touch tap or arrows + space, 1-6 fabrics, Q / E thread, Z undo, R redo block, P pause, M sound

name: Brakefall
mechanic: hold to brake a runaway ore cart while brake heat fades the shoes, crawling posted hairpins and rotten trestles, outrunning the collapse dust to bank the load at the flooded sump
theme: the last working gangway of a lamplit copper mine, five switchback flights above a flooded sump
tagline: Gravity is the engine. The brake is the whole job.
controls: hold space / mouse / touch to brake, P pause, M sound, R restart

name: Exact Change
mechanic: count exact change out of the till coin by coin before each customer's patience drains, chasing speed tips, streak bonuses and fewest-coin regulars through a rush minute
theme: a sun-bright harbour sweet shop on its record Saturday
tagline: Every penny counted. Every mood kept.
controls: mouse / touch tap coins or keys 1-9, 0, Backspace undo, C clear, Enter hands over, P pause, M sound, R new day

name: Poise
mechanic: hang carved weights anywhere along a mobile's arms so every rod settles level at once, reading each arm's tip arrow before you commit
theme: a lamplit sculptor's studio finishing five kinetic mobiles before the gallery opens at dawn
tagline: Everything hangs in the balance.
controls: mouse / touch drag or arrows + space to lift, slide & drop, Esc returns a carving, P pause, R restart piece, M sound
